facts: zend_throw_error(NULL, "Method %s::__toString() must return a string value", ZSTR_VAL(ce->name));

cases.retained_argument: cast occurs during strlen; no destructor until caller unsets retained object
cases.temporary_argument: cast then destructor occur before the next statement
cases.dynamic_native_call: same cast and temporary-destruction order through a dynamic callable
cases.throwing_cast: cast write is retained; destructor runs before catch; normal continuation is skipped
cases.reentrant_destructor: outer destructor re-enters strlen; inner temporary is destroyed before outer destructor resumes
cases.observable_effects: Stringable writes persist; selected destructor output is observable
